approvers: None, I decide alone; site manager would have to confirm it saves rework
reason: Film and tape cost me almost nothing and my crew puts it on, so I will not pay about 19 euro per m2 for a coating I have never seen used on a Maltese job. I have not been budgeting for this and damage to glazing is something I absorb in the job margin.
objection: 19 euro per m2 against film and tape at well under 1 euro per m2 in material. A 2,500 euro damage cap does not cover what I would spend across a block, and nobody here has used it on a real job.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape, and keep absorbing the occasional broken or scratched pane as part of the job cost.
would_change_my_mind: A local reference block where I can see the damage savings, and a price close to 5 to 6 euro per m2 all-in, or proof that my last block lost more to glazing damage than this would cost.
